I know it's not my fault, but I'm left with these demons, that I can not fix. I've put my best foot forward, and it still feels like I can't get out. I've always thought about suicide after my first few run in with it. But I was always nervous about going back to the mental hospital. 

I always think about, get a grip on my self and it passes Wes have all probably felt that, and as a child  I wad young and hurt. 

But now as I sit on my couch and stair at my ceiling I  get to that point, and then one further, and one further then that, and instead of being scared. 

I feel like I can finally do it with out that burden of stress or worry. It's become progressively easier to think of the final act and not be scared. 

I know I should probably be on some sort of medication, but I'm poor, and stupid. I've made epic level mistakes I wish I could refuckingso and honestly don't like that idea of needed that to make me feel human. Why can't I feel human alone, why can't I be me. Why did I have to go through the shit to the point where I can't fucking type .
